svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.17.1.1 Application
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.17 COLUMNS
Application

g.text: Column under a beam carrying loads from
not more than 2 wood-frame floors: supported
joist length not over 5 m (16′-4⅞″), live load
Columns under beams carrying not more than
2 levels of decks or balconies, or 1 level plus
the roof: joists not over 5 m, snow + occupancy
not over 4.8 kPa (100 psf), single suite, Clause (1)(b)

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
This Section applies to columns used to
support
(a) beams carrying loads from not more than 2
wood-frame floors where the supported length of
joists bearing on the beams does not exceed 5 m
and the live load on any floor does not exceed
2.4 kPa (50.1 psf) (see Table 4.1.5.3.), (b)
beams or header joists carrying loads from not
more than 2 levels of wood-frame balconies, decks
or other accessible exterior platforms, or 1
level plus the roof, where the supported length
of joists does not exceed 5 m, the sum of the
specified snow and occupancy loads does not
exceed 4.8 kPa (100 psf) (see Sentence
9.4.2.3.(1)) and the platform serves only a
single suite of residential occupancy, or (c)
carport roofs (see Section 9.35.).
Columns for other applications are designed in
accordance with Part 4.
The supported length is half of the joist
spans on each side of the beam
Drawn in A: joists of 4.9 m on each side of the beam, so the supported length is 4.9 m. Other sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.17.1.1. (page 9-131), with Note A-9.17.3.4.
